text: Let's go to the first email. It says, Leaving my single parent, mother and elder brother behind. I hope you're doing well. I watch your Ask Ganji Soek sessions quite regularly. And after thinking so much, I decided to share my guilt of leaving Pakistan with you. I believe you'll give me good advice. I'm 26-year-old woman and I was raised by a single parent, my mother, since I was born. As my father died when I was six days old. I'm sorry to hear that. I have an elder brother. My mother and brother are extremely supportive in every way. I'm not going to tell all the difficulties and hard times I have experienced in my life. I know that everyone can imagine how difficult it must be for a widow and her children to live a life on their own without any support, be it financial or financial.
